summary: Frame Studio Phase 1 full-stack tested end-to-end. 18/18 backend pytest cases pass covering auth (signup/login/me/duplicate/invalid token), projects CRUD + owner isolation, pipeline synopsis/script/character-image/storyboard, media serving with token auth (403 on bad token, 422 on missing token), featured, and video start (QUEUED+prediction_id when storyboard present, 400 when absent, soft-delete). Frontend tested via mobile viewport (390x844): welcome -> login -> Home lands correctly, session persists across reload, Profile shows user + Log Out returns to welcome, My List lists both existing test projects with correct scene counts, project detail (/project/[id]) shows synopsis + testID present, full Create flow (Studio idea -> Next -> CreateWorkSheet with 3 scenes/portrait/Live-Action -> Start Creating -> /create/pipeline?projectId=... -> synopsis auto-generated and rendered under testID='synopsis-title'). Design system correct (dark ink bg, purple #8B5CF6 CTAs), 44px touch targets on tab bar and buttons.

minor.issue: Missing token returns 422 (FastAPI Query validation) instead of 403. Not a bug but not consistent with the review spec that says 'wrong/missing token returns 403'. Wrong token correctly returns 403.

issues: TextInputs and primary buttons (Sign In, Sign Up, Continue, etc.) do NOT have testID attributes. Tests must fall back to placeholder/text selectors which is brittle.
'Next' button and idea TextInput do not have testID attributes; identified only via visible text/placeholder.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely coming from a react-native-web component (possibly Pressable/Modal wrappers). Non-blocking but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents. Reference: emitted during initial /auth screen render.

action_items: Add testID to auth screens: email-input, password-input, name-input, confirm-password-input, login-submit, signup-submit, welcome-get-started, welcome-have-account.
Add testID to studio.tsx Next button ('studio-next-button') and idea TextInput ('studio-idea-input') for reliable E2E automation.
Optional: normalise missing-token on /api/files to 403 (custom Query validator or FastAPI dependency) to match spec.
Migrate any component still using the pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to remove the deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: core.py hard-codes a fallback APP_URL that points to a specific preview host; acceptable for now but risky if the preview slug changes. Prefer failing fast if APP_URL is missing.
routes.py serialize_project rebuilds media_url on every serialisation which mints a fresh 12h JWT per call — fine, but any client caching should be aware URLs rotate.
video poll archives to storage inside the poll endpoint; a slow download can time out the mobile client. Consider a short-lived redirect or background task later.
seed_data_creation: Created one throwaway signup account (test_<uuid>@frame.studio) for owner-isolation tests and one TEST_Auto project which was soft-deleted at end of the run. One additional video render was NOT triggered on the pre-existing sample project (spec: at most one new render). One new Luma prediction WAS started (single scene of the freshly created TEST_Auto project) to verify the QUEUED+prediction_id contract, per spec (single render allowed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test credentials: test@frame.studio / password123. Backend base: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Pre-existing projects for that user: 'One Second for You' (Outlined, 0/3) and 'Fired by Love, Hunted by Fortune' (In Production, 1/3 with scene 1 READY video). Full pytest suite in /app/backend/tests/test_frame_studio.py runs in ~60s. Video render tests intentionally start only one Luma prediction to control cost — do not add loops that render every scene. Missing-token on /api/files currently returns 422 (Query required) not 403.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs blocking review acceptance. Only minor gaps: missing testIDs on auth/studio screens and the 422-vs-403 spec mismatch on /api/files with omitted token param.
